submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the front free anatomical RIGHT knee-to-boot chain of image1, the exact ice-sword girl's E16 running frame. One full square transparent RGBA native >=1024 sprite. Upper body, face, head, hair, robe, right hand holding ice sword behind, left hand holding blue rectangular talisman in front, weapons, camera, scale, frame registration, and rear anatomical LEFT supporting leg all stay exactly as image1. Do not copy image2's entire pose; it is only the preceding frame's revised leg reference. Image3 is project style. Image4 is only external gait reference, never identity or costume.
The front RIGHT boot should continue forward and DOWN from the new E15 in image2 toward the upcoming landing. Reduce the old excessive forward kick distance a little by keeping a softly bent knee and the ankle closer beneath the front knee. Point the boot to SCREEN RIGHT with nearly horizontal sole and only minimal toe lift; avoid a big sole display or outward yaw. Its bottom is a little LOWER than image2's free front boot, but still above the rear LEFT forefoot's ground height: E16 remains left-supported, right front foot is about to land at E01. Keep the rear left forefoot contact position fixed and its heel raised for push-off, keeping the original limb lengths and limb ownership. Only this small local change; absolutely no full-character shifting or rescaling. Preserve natural anatomical knee–ankle–shoe alignment, two legs and two arms, one sword and one talisman. No text, grid, background, shadow, extra anatomy, pose cloning or cropping.
